description: Jupiter produces the strongest auroras in the solar system. These features glow brightly around its poles as energetic particles crash into the giant planet's atmosphere. New observations have now revealed that Jupiter's moons can disturb this glowing display in unexpected ways. Scientists using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have identified unusual "cold footprints" forming inside the auroras. This effect is caused by the interaction between the moons and Jupiter's immense magnetic field.
title: James Webb Telescope Captures Rare Infrared Footprints of Io and Ganymede Inside Jupiter’s Auroras

description: The Society Season 2 is out now on OTT. Following the successful completion of the first season, the Munawar Faruqui-hosted show has launched a new instalment. While it retains the same core concept, it introduces several upgrades and a unique twist. The Society is currently streaming on JioHotstar. Viewers will require a subscription to the streaming service to watch it online.
title: The Society Season 2 OTT Release: Where to Watch Munawar Faruqui and Shreya Kalra’s Reality Survival Series?

description: Lockdown is an Anupama Parameswaran-starrer Tamil psychological thriller now streaming on digital platforms. The plot centres on a period of national emergency, specifically the pandemic, when an incident turned the life of a young girl, the eldest daughter of her family, upside down. This film is now available to stream exclusively on Amazon Prime Video, in Hindi, Tamil, and Malayalam languages.
title: Lockdown Available for Streaming Online: Where to Watch Anupama Parameswaran’s Intense Survival Thriller?

description: Pearl Abyss has finally revealed detailed PC, console, and Mac specs for its upcoming open world action-adventure title, Crimson Desert. The game will run at 60fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X, but only at full-HD resolution. In Quality mode, Crimson Desert will run at 30fps with 1440p resolution upscaled to 4K. Here are detailed specs for the game across all supported platforms.
title: Crimson Desert PC and Console Specs Revealed: Here's How the Game Will Run on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X

description: Amazon, on Monday, won a court order blocking Perplexity from deploying its artificial intelligence (AI) shopping agents on its e-commerce platform. The decision was given by a California federal judge, who found that the Seattle-based tech giant had strong evidence of unauthorised access by Perplexity’s bots. With this, Amazon has received preliminary injunctive relief, which will take effect in seven days.
title: Perplexity Ordered to Stop Deploying Shopping AI Agents on Amazon: Report

description: Sonos has launched two new speakers, the Sonos Play and Sonos Era 100 SL, expanding its home audio lineup. Both speakers support Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, Apple AirPlay 2, and multi-room playback through the Sonos app. The Sonos Play features a 35Wh battery with up to 24 hours of playback and an IP67 rating, while the Era 100 SL requires wired power. Both models use triple amplifier audio systems with dual tweeters and a mid-woofer. They are priced at $299 (roughly Rs. 27,500) and $189 (roughly Rs. 17,400), respectively.
title: Sonos Play and Sonos Era 100 SL Launched With Wi-Fi 6 Connectivity, AirPlay 2 Support: Price, Features

description: WhatsApp has announced a new feature through which parents or guardians would be given more controls to oversee communication settings and restrict various features so that pre-teen users may focus on messaging and calling. Parent-managed accounts are to be rolled out over the coming months. It has been developed with feedback from families and experts to create a more controlled environment for kids under 13 who are starting to use WhatsApp’s messaging services.
title: WhatsApp Adds Support for Parent-Managed Accounts With Stricter Controls for Children Under 13

description: Canva, on Wednesday, announced a new artificial intelligence (AI) tool for users. Dubbed Magic Layers, it can convert any flat or static image and AI-generated outputs into a layered, editable design. This means users can take any image and then manipulate its elements individually to create a different design. The Sydney-based visual communication platform stated that the tool was developed using an in-house foundation model.
title: Canva’s New AI-Powered Magic Layers Feature Turns Images Into Editable Designs

description: Oppo Find N6 will be equipped with the “world’s flattest foldable display” (translated from Chinese), the Chinese tech firm claimed in a social media post on Wednesday. The phone will launch with the “Sky-Shaped Memory Glass” and the next-generation “Titanium Alloy Sky-Shaped Hinge” that will allow the Oppo Find N6 to offer a crease-free experience. Additionally, the smartphone is now available for pre-order in China. The listing reveals that the foldable will be offered in Deep Black, Golden Orange, and Original Titanium colour options.
title: Oppo Find N6 Colourways, Storage Variants Revealed as Company Teases Crease-Free Display's Components

description: Realme will soon launch a new P4 series smartphone in India as the dedicated microsite for the handset is now live in the country. While the microsite does not reveal the name, the URL confirms that the upcoming smartphone is going to be called the Realme P4 Lite 5G. Moreover, the company has teased the design of the new Realme P series model, which suggests that it might carry a triple rear camera unit, paired with an LED flash. This comes soon after the Chinese smartphone maker launched the Realme P4 Lite in the country.
title: Realme P4 Lite 5G India Launch Teased as Company Hints at Design and Availability

description: Tokenised real-world assets have grown sharply in 2026, with the sector expanding by about 66 percent, according to DeFiLlama data. The growth reflects rising interest in bringing traditional financial instruments such as bonds, credit products, and commodities onto blockchain networks, a trend analysts say is attracting institutional investors.
title: Tokenised Real-World Assets See 66 Percent Jump in 2026, DeFiLlama Data Shows

description: Xiaomi 17, Samsung Galaxy S26, and iPhone 17 are compact flagship smartphones with 6.3-inch OLED displays and high-end chipsets. The Xiaomi 17 runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and offers a large 6,330mAh battery with fast charging. The Galaxy S26 is powered by Samsung’s Exynos 2600 processor and features a Dynamic AMOLED 2X display. Apple’s iPhone 17 uses the A19 chip and runs on iOS 26. Camera systems differ across the three phones, with Xiaomi offering triple 50-megapixel sensors, Samsung a triple setup, and Apple a dual camera system.
title: Xiaomi 17 vs Samsung Galaxy S26 vs iPhone 17: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Prakash Jha is back with his latest directorial venture, Sankalp, which has finally reached digital screens. This 10-episode socio-political series centres on a teacher whose life takes a dramatic turn when one of his former students becomes his political opponent. The series is now available to stream exclusively on Amazon MX Player. There are 10 episodes in the series, and they are all available in Hindi.
title: Sankalp Now Streaming on OTT: What You Need to Know About Nana Patekar and Prakash Jha’s Series

description: The CBI has arrested Darwin Labs co-founder and CTO Ayush Varshney in connection with the GainBitcoin cryptocurrency scam. Investigators allege the scheme promised investors fixed Bitcoin returns through cloud mining but operated as a Ponzi-style operation. Authorities claim the technical infrastructure, including the MCAP token and related platforms, helped facilitate the alleged fraud.
title: GainBitcoin Crypto Scam Case: CBI Arrests Darwin Labs CTO and Co-Founder Ayush Varshney

description: YouTube began rolling out its Likeness Detection tool to creators on the platform in October 2025. The tool was designed to monitor videos on the platform that mimic the likeness of a user's face or voice without consent. The feature was part of the Google-owned video streaming giant’s initiative to protect users from the harmful usage of artificial intelligence (AI).
title: YouTube’s Likeness Detection Tool Expanded to Government Officials and Journalists

description: Aamir Khan has changed his mind, and following the YouTube rental experiment, Sitaare Zameen Par is ready to debut on OTT. The news has already garnered significant attention, as the film is highly anticipated. The story centres on individuals with autism who, despite often being neglected by society, play basketball exceptionally well. A remake of the Spanish film Campeones (Champions), the movie features Aamir Khan as their coach. According to reports, Sitaare Zameen Par will be available to watch on Sony Liv soon.
title: Sitaare Zameen Par Reportedly Set for OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Aamir Khan and Genelia Deshmukh Starrer Online?

description: While generative artificial intelligence (AI) gained mainstream attention after the launch of GPT-3 in 2020, the underlying technology, machine learning, is decades old. From typing prediction in keyboard apps to recommendation algorithms in social media platforms, all rely on the same technology and have contributed to what AI has become today. One definitive precursor of modern-day AI is said to be AlphaGo, a system created by Google DeepMind in 2016.
title: AlphaGo Turns 10: How DeepMind’s Breakthrough Set the Stage for AGI

description: The BenQ GV32 projector was launched in India recently. The company positions it as a portable projector, which is also capable of projecting on the roof, owing to its sturdy magnetic stand. Available for purchase on Flipkart and Amazon in India at Rs. 49,990, the BenQ GV32 offers great value. Its functional design and impressive build quality set it apart from the competition. While 1080p playback might disappoint you, the video remains crisp even at a 120-inch projection.
title: BenQ GV32 Projector Review: Strikes a Nostalgic Chord

description: Changpeng Zhao has reportedly added about $47 billion to his wealth over the past year, pushing the Binance founder higher on global billionaire rankings. However, Zhao has questioned the interpretation of the figures, noting that cryptocurrency prices have fallen significantly in 2026. His comments have sparked debate over how wealth estimates for major crypto entrepreneurs are calculated.
title: Binance Founder Changpeng Zhao Questions Forbes Wealth Ranking After $47 Billion Surge

description: Poco X8 Pro 5G will be equipped with a 6,500mAh battery, the Xiaomi sub-brand revealed on Wednesday. The company claims that the smartphone will provide more than two days of battery backup. On the other hand, the flagship Poco X8 Pro Max 5G will be backed by a 9,000mAh cell. The company revealed the battery capacities of both upcoming handsets after updating the dedicated microsite on Flipkart, which was recently made live. The Poco X8 Pro lineup is scheduled to be launched in India next week, on March 17.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series Battery Capacity and Other Key Features Revealed as India Launch Nears

description: The PS Plus Game Catalogue lineup for March has leaked. According to a noted leaker, Sony will add Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, Persona 5 Royal, Metal Eden, Astroneer, Madden NFL 26, and The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria to Game Catalogue on March 17.
title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Lineup for March Will Reportedly Include Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2

description: Samsung’s Galaxy A57 has reportedly appeared on a European retailer’s website ahead of launch, revealing official-looking renders. The phone appears with a flat display, slim bezels, and a vertical triple rear camera setup inside a pill-shaped module. It is expected to feature a 6.7-inch 120Hz full-HD+ Super AMOLED display and Samsung’s Exynos 1680 chipset. The handset may offer up to 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. It is tipped to include a 50-megapixel triple rear camera system and a 5,000mAh battery with 45W charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 Renders Leak Online Again via Retailer Listing; Launch Expected Soon

description: Vivo Y51 Pro 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the Chinese smartphone maker’s Y series. The phone is scheduled to go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Vivo India online store. It will be available for purchase in 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The phone will be offered in two colour options, dubbed Festive Red and Noble Gold. It is backed by a 7,200mAh battery with support for 44W wired fast charging. A 4nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset powers the new smartphone.
title: Vivo Y51 Pro 5G Launched in India With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The Government of India recently enforced a SIM binding policy for messaging and financial services with the aim of reducing digital fraud and misuse of identities. Cybersecurity experts, however, claim to have identified a toolkit that is aimed at evading these restrictions by directly targeting the Android operating system and accessing messages and the victims' UPI accounts without authorisation.
title: New 'Digital Lutera' Android Toolkit Can Hijack Your UPI Account

description: Google added new capabilities to the Gemini assistant in Workspace apps on Tuesday. The Mountain View-based tech giant said that Gemini in Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive is now more personalised, capable, and collaborative. The biggest upgrade is that the artificial intelligence (AI) tool can now create a final draft from scratch with a single prompt, something it could not do earlier.
title: Google Upgrades Gemini Side Panel in Workspace Apps With New Features

description: Laptop prices are set to shoot up in the next few months as the prices of components are rising. A report has stated that laptop prices are set to rise up to 35 percent as the prices of major components, including memory and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), are rising. The demand for these components is reportedly surging as companies are still in the process of developing data centres to keep up with the booming AI market.
title: Laptop Prices Reportedly Set to Surge Up to 35 Percent as AI Boom Drives Component Demand

description: Redmi K90 Ultra key specifications and features have been tipped ahead of its anticipated launch. A tipster claims that the smartphone will be powered by the flagship octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. It is also said to pack a battery larger than 8,000mAh. Moreover, the purported Redmi K90 Ultra is expected to be equipped with a 1.5K resolution display, which might offer up to 165Hz of refresh rate. The leaked specifications are in line with previous leaks, which also suggested that the phone might launch with a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra Tipped to Feature 165Hz Display, Battery Capacity Could Exceed 8,000mAh

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 series smartphones are now available for purchase in India after their global debut on February 25. The lineup includes the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra. The Ultra runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, while the other two use Samsung’s Exynos 2600 processor. Prices start at Rs. 87,999 for the Galaxy S26 and go up to Rs. 1,89,999 for the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26 Ultra Goes on Sale in India: Price, Features

description: Bitcoin held near the $70,000 level on Wednesday as geopolitical tensions and macro uncertainty kept investors cautious. Analysts said ETF inflows and tight exchange reserves continue to support demand, while derivatives data suggest traders are positioning for potential upside. Ethereum and major altcoins tracked Bitcoin’s sideways movement, as markets awaited clearer signals from global developments.
title: Bitcoin Drops Under $70,000 as Crypto Traders Remain Cautious Amidst Ongoing Geopolitical Tensions

description: Apple refreshed its hardware lineup last week with the launch of iPhone 17e, MacBook Air (M5), MacBook Pro (2026), Studio Display, and Studio Display XDR, as part of the “special Apple experience” held in London, New York, and Shanghai. Alongside, the Cupertino-based tech giant’s first-ever low-cost MacBook, dubbed MacBook Neo, also broke cover. All of the new products will be available for purchase in India and the global markets beginning today (Wednesday).
title: iPhone 17e, MacBook Neo, iPad Air, Refreshed MacBook Pro and MacBook Air Models Go on Sale in India: Price, Availability

description: Capcom has announced that Resident Evil Requiem is getting a story expansion. The DLC is now in development, but it will be some time before it's ready for release, the company said. Capcom also confirmed new content and updates for Requiem, including a photo mode and a mini game.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Story Expansion Is in Development, Capcom Confirms

description: Xiaomi 17 Ultra has been launched in India by the Chinese smartphone maker, along with the new Xiaomi 17. The flagship Xiaomi 17 Ultra is scheduled to go on sale in the country via Amazon and the Xiaomi India online store. The tech giant claims that the Ultra model is the world’s first smartphone to be equipped with Leica’s 1-inch LOFIC sensor. The handset carries a triple rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter, a 200-megapixel telephoto camera, ana 50-megapixel ultrawide camera. The phone is powered by Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Launched in India With 200-Megapixel Leica Camera with Continuous Optical Zoom: Price, Features

description: Adobe has started rolling out the public beta version of the AI assistant feature in Photoshop, the San Jose-based tech firm announced on Tuesday. The company said that users will now be able to edit images with the help of text-based prompts. For example, users can ask the AI assistant to remove distractions, change the background, adjust colours, and refine the lighting of an image using prompts. First announced in October 2025, during the company’s annual creativity conference Adobe Max 2025, the feature is available as a beta in the Photoshop web and mobile app versions.
title: Adobe Photoshop Updated With AI Assistant; Firefly Image Gets New Editor Features

description: Rising memory prices have once again shuffled and shaken up the budget smartphone segment. Devices that could once pass off as basic budget smartphones now fall in the upper-end of the budget smartphone segment. And with these increasing price tags is the obvious decreasing value. Luckily we do have a bunch of smartphones that have received price cuts and are now available at a lower price.
title: Best Mobiles Under Rs. 20,000 in India: From Poco M8, Moto G96, CMF Phone 2 Pro and More

description: Gadgets 360 has learned from sources that iQOO plans to change its usual release schedule for one of its most popular smartphone lineups in India, the Neo series. It typically represents the upper mid-range segment of Vivo’s sub-brand lineup. The iQOO Neo series handsets often offer a combination of near-flagship-level chipsets, high refresh rate displays, and fast charging capabilities, at a competitive price point. While the brand has indeed been busy with recent launches like the iQOO 15R, sources say that iQOO is shifting its focus away from the Neo series in 2026.
title: Exclusive: iQOO Neo Series to Skip 2026 Launch as Brand Refines Flagship Strategy

description: Google released its first fully multimodal embedding model on Tuesday. Dubbed Gemini Embedding 2, the artificial intelligence (AI) model maps text, images, audio, and videos into a single, unified embedding space. This means it uses a architecture to understand concepts whether they are written as words, spoken aloud, or shown in an image or a video.
title: Google Unveils Gemini Embedding 2, Its First AI Model to Map Text, Images and Video Together

description: Oppo Find X10 series may include the Find X10, Find X10 Pro, and Find X10 Pro Max. Leaks suggest the Find X10 may feature a 6.59-inch 1.5K display, while the Pro could offer a 6.78-inch 1.5K panel. The Pro Max display is yet to be finalised. All three models may run on the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 chipset, though earlier reports mentioned a Dimensity 9500+ for the base model. The series may also skip upgrades to LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5.0 storage.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Tipped to Launch Without Memory Upgrades; Display Sizes Leak

description: Xiaomi 17 has launched in India alongside the Xiaomi 17 Ultra, powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset built on a 3nm process. The phone features a 6.3-inch CrystalRes OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 3,500 nits brightness. It offers up to 16GB LPDDR5X RAM and 512GB UFS 4.1 storage. The handset includes a Leica-backed triple 50-megapixel rear camera setup and a 50-megapixel front camera. It packs a 6,330mAh battery with 100W wired and 50W wireless charging.
title: Xiaomi 17 Launched in India With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, Triple Leica Rear Camera Setup: Price, Features

description: Apple and Samsung usually compete for the mantle of the best smartphone on the planet, courtesy of their respective iPhone Pro and Galaxy S lineups each year. The same story continues this year, with the recently launched Galaxy S26 Ultra competing against the iPhone 17 Pro models. However, when pitted against each other, the iPhone 17 Pro outperformed the Galaxy S26 Ultra in DxOMark’s comprehensive camera evaluation, despite Samsung’s inclusion of the 200-megapixel sensor.
title: iPhone 17 Pro Outperforms Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra in DxOMark’s Camera Evaluation

description: The Vivo X300 Ultra is rumoured to be launched in China soon as the latest addition to the X300 series. While the handset was showcased at the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 earlier this month, the company remains tight-lipped when it comes to its launch date. A tipster, however, has shed light on its possible debut date in China, indicating the company may launch the X300 Ultra towards the end of the month.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Could Launch in China Towards the End of March, Claims Tipster

description: Google announced the expansion of Gemini in Chrome to India on Wednesday. The artificial intelligence (AI)-powered assistant for the browser was first released in select markets in September 2025, and now the company is expanding it to more regions. Gemini in Chrome appears as a side panel on the right side of the browser and can answer any question about the webpage.
title: Google Expands Gemini in Chrome to India With Support for 8 Indic Languages
